mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_identities ( id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, external_did, verified_at, metadata, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerSubject}, #{externalDid}, #{verifiedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, CAST(#{metadata, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, external_did, verified_at, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_user_identities WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, external_did, verified_at, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_user_identities WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_subject = #{providerSubject}

SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, external_did, verified_at, metadata::text AS metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_user_identities WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
